mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STAT_CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IN_PROGRESS_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STAT_CD = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STOP_COUNT FROM TB_TASK WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT T.TASK_ID, T.TASK_NM, E.EMP_NM AS TASK_MNGR_NM, T.TASK_END_DT, T.TASK_PRIORITY_CD FROM TB_TASK T LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON T.TASK_MNGR_ID = E.EMP_ID WHERE T.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.TASK_STAT_CD != '02' AND T.TASK_END_DT BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + 7 ORDER BY T.TASK_END_DT ASC
